questions.question: What part of the temple does Ezekiel 41 mainly measure?
options: The wide outer courtyard and all of its many gates
The great bronze altar of the burnt offering outside
The side chambers where the serving priests ate their bread
The nave and the Most Holy Place (inner sanctuary)
questions.answer: The nave and the Most Holy Place (inner sanctuary)

questions.question: What decorations are described on the temple walls?
options: Inscriptions of the law of Moses
Images of the sun and the moon
